summary: Iteration 4 — DaySync category CRUD + dark mode. Backend 36/36 pytest passed (15 new category tests + 21 regression auth/tenant/events/tasks/logo). New tests cover defaults on fresh company (5 seeded: work/meeting/deadline/personal/focus), slug generation (Client Call -> client-call, dedupe -> client-call-2), auto-tinted bg from hex, admin CRUD, employee 403 on POST/PATCH/DELETE, employee can GET, /auth/me + /api/company include categories, PATCH auto-refreshes bg on color change, DELETE last remaining returns 400, missing key -> 404. Frontend UI verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): Profile Appearance section renders 3 buttons with testIDs theme-light/theme-dark/theme-system. Tapping Dark switches whole app to dark theme (Profile, Admin, tabs all render on dark bg), persisted at localStorage['daysync.theme_mode']='dark' and survives page reload. Admin 'Event types' section lists all 5 default categories with pencil + trash icons; Add event type flow (cat-new -> cat-new-label -> cat-new-save) created 'sprint' successfully; inline edit via cat-edit-{key} + cat-save-{key} updated the label; cat-delete-{key} removed it. Both features are working as designed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:220-226 default categories seeded per-company in register_company via 'categories': [dict(c) for c in DEFAULT_CATEGORIES] — good (deep copies avoid shared-reference mutations).
server.py:471-477 slug generation lower-cases + non-alnum -> '-' + de-duplicates with -2/-3 suffix; correctly handles 'Client Call' -> 'client-call' and repeat -> 'client-call-2'.
server.py:498-511 PATCH auto-refreshes tinted bg via _hex_to_bg when color changes but bg is not explicitly provided — matches product intent.
server.py:521-522 DELETE guard 'len(cats) <= 1' correctly returns 400 with 'At least one category is required' preventing empty state.
server.py:288 public_company includes 'categories': c.get('categories', DEFAULT_CATEGORIES) so /auth/me and /api/company both expose the current list to the frontend.
ThemeContext uses storage key 'daysync.theme_mode' (verified from localStorage after tapping Dark) and re-loads on app boot — persistence works across reloads.
Category endpoints correctly gated: GET uses get_current_user (employees allowed), POST/PATCH/DELETE use require_admin (employees get 403) — verified by tests.
